Vouched Entry.name: Vouched Entry
Vouched Entry.description: The user calls in favors and gets vouched for to reach people who never talk to strangers: a forger, a fixer, a dealer in illegal support gear. The user gets a meeting with an underworld broker who can supply a specific illegal item, service or piece of information, and the broker does not suspect the user is police or a hero unless the user gives it away. Cost: none.
